heading: Today
text: Rain and snow spreading northeast, steadiest south of Rt. 4.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Any rain changing to snow Adirondacks and Rt. 2 south, up to 4 inches far south, flurries north.

heading: Friday
text: Early snow tapering to snow or rain showers.

heading: Saturday
text: Mostly cloudy. Some afternoon snow showers north.
